title: Orbitus chat assistant trial results
brief: I'm the head of customer experience at Orbitus Mobile and I need a results report on our chat assistant trial for the leadership team, who were not involved and will read it on laptops on 2026-10-23. The trial ran 2026-09-07 to 2026-10-16 and covered 14200 chats. Headline numbers: 38 percent of chats resolved by the assistant without a person, average handling time down from 11.4 to 8.7 minutes, and customer satisfaction of 4.1 out of 5 against 4.3 for chats with people. Under "Weekly resolution" chart the share resolved by the assistant: W37 29, W38 33, W39 36, W40 40, W41 43, W42 46. Under "By topic" give a table of chats, percent resolved by the assistant and satisfaction: Billing 4300, 51, 4.4; Plan changes 3100, 42, 4.3; Coverage 2400, 39, 4.2; Device help 3600, 27, 3.9; Cancellations 800, 6, 3.2. Cancellations is the outlier, because customers asking to leave wanted a person and said so, and this must be flagged. Under "Recommendation", as a short list: roll out to billing, plan changes and coverage from 2026-11-16, keep device help in trial until it passes 40 percent, and send cancellations straight to people.

edit.request: Add W43 at 48 to the chart and change the rollout date to 2026-11-30.
